note: Documented individual cut/loss events for Romania's PNRR, curated by hand from press coverage (no official API publishes this as a clean dataset). These are the major reported events, not a fully non-overlapping waterfall — e.g. the May 2026 permanent loss is part of the payment-request-3 amount suspended in May 2025. The plan's total fell from an original €29.2bn (2021) to €20.1bn (2026), a €9.1bn reduction concentrated almost entirely in the loan component.

events.reason: Recalculated allocation formula — Romania's pandemic-era economic performance came in better than the 2021 estimate, lowering the grant total

Loan component cut — projects judged unfinishable by the Aug 2026 deadline were dropped; some investments (e.g. highway sections with failed tenders, unfinished hospitals) were moved to EU cohesion funds instead

European Commission suspended payment on request #3 over 3 unmet milestones — this money was earmarked for: AMEPIP (public-enterprise oversight authority) operationalization, administrator/board appointments at state energy & transport companies, and a special/magistrate pensions reform
Definitively lost from the May 2025 suspended amount — mostly from failed administrator/director selection procedures at state energy and transport companies, plus part of the pensions reform

breakdown.label: Energy companies (Hidroelectrica, Romgaz, Nuclearelectrica director selection)
Remainder (AMEPIP-related, not itemized in press coverage)
